description.en: SpatialWorld evaluates multimodal agents on interactive spatial reasoning in 760 real-world tasks across eight simulation backends. Agents operate under vision-only partial observability, using a unified text-based action interface. Performance is measured via terminal-state verifiers for task success rate and step efficiency.

evidence.snippet: We introduce SpatialWorld, a unified benchmark designed specifically for evaluating the interactive spatial understanding of multimodal agents in complex real-world tasks.

claire_radar.motivation: Spatial reasoning is a foundational capability for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perceive and operate within the physical world.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing benchmarks rely on passive VQA or simulator-specific pipelines, failing to assess interactive spatial understanding. SpatialWorld provides a unified, simulator-agnostic protocol with human-validated evaluation, revealing that current models achieve low success rates, highlighting gaps in active exploration and long-horizon planning.
